availability.title: Availability
availability.intro: Set blockers for times you're unavailable. During a blocker you won't receive any class notifications — no automatic invitations, and no invitations or reminders sent by your coach. Your coach can still add you to a class manually, but cannot notify you during that period.
availability.formDescription: Choose a one-time date or a recurring weekly pattern.
availability.blockersActiveDescription: During these windows you won't receive auto-invitations.
availability.noBlockersEmpty: No blockers yet. Add one to stop auto-invitations when you're unavailable.
availability.wontReceive: Won't receive auto-invitations during this time.
availability.dateRequiredDescription: Please pick a date for the blocker.
